info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/motion-control
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/motion-control queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Kling V3 (pro) Motion Control API.

Generate videos where character actions match a reference video while
the visual appearance is based on a reference image. Pro mode generates
higher quality video output.

V3 adds support for element binding to enhance facial consistency.
When an element is provided, the character's facial identity is better
preserved across the generated video. Element binding requires
character_orientation='video'.

Character orientation controls output pose direction and video limits:
- 'video': Matches reference video orientation - better for complex motions (max 30s)
- 'image': Matches reference image orientation - better for camera movements (max 10s)

keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the original sound from the reference video.
keep_original_sound.title: Keep Original Sound

elements.description: Optional element for facial consistency binding. Upload a facial element to enhance identity preservation in the generated video. Only 1 element is supported. Reference in prompt as @Element1. Element binding is only supported when character_orientation is 'video'.
elements.title: Elements

image_url.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 340px, Min height: 340px, Max width: 3850px, Max height: 3850px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s
image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Reference image URL. The characters, backgrounds, and other elements in the generated video are based on this reference image. Characters should have clear body proportions, avoid occlusion, and occupy more than 5% of the image area.

character_orientation.description: Controls whether the output character's orientation matches the reference image or video. 'video': orientation matches reference video - better for complex motions (max 30s). 'image': orientation matches reference image - better for following camera movements (max 10s).
character_orientation.title: Character Orientation

enable_safety_checker.description: Disabling safety checks requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

video_url.limit_description: Max file size: 100.0MB, Min width: 340px, Min height: 340px, Max width: 3850px, Max height: 3850px, Min duration: 3.0s, Max duration: 30.05s, Timeout: 30.0s
video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: Reference video URL. The character actions in the generated video will be consistent with this reference video. Should contain a realistic style character with entire body or upper body visible, including head, without obstruction. Duration limit depends on character_orientation: 10s max for 'image', 30s max for 'video'.

frontal_image_url.description: The frontal image of the element (main view).

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 50.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url

reference_image_urls.description: Additional reference images from different angles. 1-3 images supported. At least one image is required.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 50.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
